issues.description: The UML in the problem statement and the template define Farm.singFarmSongVerse(...) as a private method, but the solution implements singFarmSongVerse(Animal) with protected visibility. This visibility mismatch between template/problem and solution can confuse students about the intended access level (private vs protected) and may lead to inconsistent implementations or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse(Animal) to private to match the UML/template, or update the UML/problem statement and template to indicate protected if a broader access level is intended. Prefer changing the solution to private if the method is meant to be an internal helper not accessed by subclasses/tests.
